title: [bug] select_channel returns announce_rx_channel without bounds validation
description: announce_rx_channel is returned directly without checking if it is in [0, n_channels-1]. A malformed Announce with channel=255 or channel=-1 passes through unvalidated, violating the documented return contract. Test: select_channel(peer_known=True, announce_rx_channel=255, n_channels=8) returns 255 instead of clamping or falling through to next priority.
